arxiv-2012-15224.title: On the Moyal Star Product of Resurgent Series
arxiv-2012-15224.creator: Y. Li, D. Sauzin, S. Sun
arxiv-2012-15224.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Y. Li, D. Sauzin, S. Sun. We analyze the Moyal star product in deformation quantization from the resurgence theory perspective. By putting algebraic conditions on Borel transforms, one can define the space of “algebro-resurgent series” (a subspace of 1 1 -Gevrey formal series in i ​ ℏ / 2 i\hbar/2 with coefficients in ℂ ​ { q , p } \mathbb{C}\{q,p\} ), which we show is stable under Moyal star product.

arxiv-2108-02439.title: Learning to Design and Construct Bridge without Blueprint
arxiv-2108-02439.creator: Yunfei Li, Tao Kong, Lei Li, Yifeng Li, Yi Wu
arxiv-2108-02439.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yunfei Li, Tao Kong, Lei Li, Yifeng Li, Yi Wu. Autonomous assembly has been a desired functionality of many intelligent robot systems. We study a new challenging assembly task, designing and constructing a bridge without a blueprint . In this task, the robot needs to first design a feasible bridge architecture for arbitrarily wide cliffs and then manipulate the blocks reliably to construct a stable bridge according to the proposed design. In this paper, we propose a bi-level approach to tackle this task.

arxiv-2108-12760.title: Inverse magneto-rotational catalysis and the phase diagram of a rotating hot and magnetized quark matter
arxiv-2108-12760.creator: N. Sadooghi a, S. M. A. Tabatabaee Mehr b, F. Taghinavaz b
arxiv-2108-12760.description: Abstract We study the properties of a hot and magnetized quark matter in a rotating cylinder in the presence of a constant magnetic field. To do this, we solve the corresponding Dirac equation using the Ritus eigenfunction method. This leads to the energy dispersion relation, Ritus eigenfunctions, and the quantization relation for magnetized fermions.

We also acknowledge support by the London Mathematical Society (SC7-1920-16).
arxiv-2109-08960.creator: Sandra Alves, Maribel Fernández, Miguel Ramos
arxiv-2109-08960.description: Abstract We define EVL , a minimal higher-order functional language to deal with generic events. The notion of generic event extends the well-known notion of event traditionally used in a variety of areas, such as database management, concurrency, reactive systems and cybersecurity. Generic events were introduced in the context of a metamodel to specify obligations in access control systems.

arxiv-2408-12350.title: Integrating high-precision and fringe-scale displacement sensing using heterodyne cavity-tracking
arxiv-2408-12350.creator: Shreevathsa Chalathadka Subrahmanya, * Christian Darsow-Fromm, and Oliver Gerberding
arxiv-2408-12350.description: Abstract We present a heterodyne stabilized cavity-based interferometer scheme that can serve as a compact and high-sensitivity displacement sensor with a fringe-scale operating range. The technique, in principle, can reach a sub-femtometer noise floor and an operating range on the order of one laser wavelength at λ ≈ \lambda\approx 1 µ ​ m 1\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m} .

arxiv-2504-07094.title: Computing Canonical Averages with Quantum and Classical Optimizers: Thermodynamic Reweighting for QUBO Models of Physical Systems
arxiv-2504-07094.creator: Francesco Slongo, Cristian Micheletti
arxiv-2504-07094.description: Abstract Abstract. We present a general method to compute canonical averages for physical models sampled via quantum or classical quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). First, we introduce a histogram reweighting scheme applicable to QUBO-based sampling constrained to specific intervals of an order parameter, e.g., physical energy.

arxiv-2508-15736.title: Connecting Discrete Morse Functions via Birth-Death Transitions
arxiv-2508-15736.creator: Chong Zheng
arxiv-2508-15736.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chong Zheng. We study transformations between discrete Morse functions on a finite simplicial complex via birth-death transitions—elementary chain maps between discrete Morse complexes that either create or cancel pairs of critical simplices. We prove that any two discrete Morse functions f 1 , f 2 : K → ℝ f_{1},f_{2}:K\to\mathbb{R} on a finite simplicial complex K K are linked by a finite sequence of such transitions.

arxiv-2509-07705.title: Efficient Generation of Second-Harmonic Propagating Spin Waves in a Thin, Out-of-Plane-Magnetized Ferromagnetic Film
arxiv-2509-07705.creator: Mathieu Moalic, Youenn Patat, Mateusz Zelent, Maciej Krawczyk
arxiv-2509-07705.description: Abstract Spin waves are attractive information carriers owing to their gigahertz-to-terahertz frequencies, nanometric wavelengths, and negligible Joule heating. Yet the efficient excitation of short-wavelength, high-frequency spin waves and the exploitation of nonlinear effects remain challenging. We propose a hybrid ferromagnetic nanostructure composed of a small, in-plane-magnetized rim (a magnonic nanocavity) exchange-coupled to an out-of-plane-magnetized region.

pmc-11549352.creator: Shajahan Anver, Ahmed Faisal Sumit, Xi-Ming Sun, Abubakar Hatimy, Konstantinos Thalassinos, Samuel Marguerat, Nazif Alic, Jürg Bähler
pmc-11549352.description: Genomes produce widespread long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) of largely unknown functions. We characterize aal1 (ageing-associated lncRNA), which is induced in quiescent fission yeast cells. Deletion of aal1 shortens the chronological lifespan of non-dividing cells, while ectopic overexpression prolongs their lifespan, indicating that aal1 acts in trans.

pmc-11688916.title: IMPROVING OUTCOMES IN OLDER VETERANS WITH HEART FAILURE AND CKD: FROM PROPENSITY SCORE USE TO AI
pmc-11688916.creator: Ali Ahmed
pmc-11688916.description: Older adults are often excluded from randomized controlled trials (RCT). Consequently, gold-standard RCT-evidence to improve outcomes in older adults is often unavailable. Properly-designed outcome-blinded propensity score matched studies can provide high-quality non-RCT evidence when RCTs are impractical, unethical, or lack sponsors. Renin-angiotensin system inhibitors (RASIs) improve outcomes in patients with heart failure (HF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD).

pmc-12432251.title: Tastes and retronasal odours evoke a shared flavour-specific neural code in the human insula
pmc-12432251.creator: Putu Agus Khorisantono, Maria G. Veldhuizen, Janina Seubert
pmc-12432251.description: During food consumption, tastes combine with retronasal odours to form flavour, which leads to a link so robust that retronasal odours can elicit taste sensations without concurrent taste stimulation. However, the cortical integration of these parallel sensory signals remains unclear.

pmc-12786455.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is among the three most commonly diagnosed malignancies worldwide and remains a major public health challenge, emphasizing the need for effective preventive strategies. pmc-13556761.title: 334. Restless legs syndrome induced by risperidone in adolescent: a case report
pmc-13556761.creator: K Saruhan
pmc-13556761.description: BackgroundRestless Leg Syndrome (RLS) is a neurological disorder that causes an urge to move the legs, accompanied by unpleasant sensations. Symptoms worsen during rest and improve with movement. It affects %5 of the population. The exact cause of primary RLS is unknown, but some theories suggest that it could be related to problems with iron metabolism or abnormal dopamine neurotransmission.

pmc-13623324.title: Novel biallelic FSIP2 variants cause male infertility with multiple morphological abnormalities of sperm flagella in humans
pmc-13623324.creator: Jie Yang, Ting-Ting He, Ya-Nan Gu, Yu Xue, Qi Chen, Man Yu, Sen Qiao, Sheng-Jia Shi
pmc-13623324.description: Biallelic variants in fibrous sheath-interacting protein 2 (FSIP2) gene are a known cause of multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF). This study aimed to identify novel FSIP2 variants and evaluate their impact on sperm ultrastructure and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) outcomes.
